name: living-drive-tonic
author: terrason
description: Protect your portable Linux (living) drive by detecting frequent write directories and redirecting them to the host's internal disk — extending SSD lifespan.

scripts.pack: bun run build --production && bun pm pack --filename package.tgz && sed -i "s/SKIP/$(sha256sum package.tgz | awk '{print $1}')/g" config/aur/PKGBUILD
